children: KINDER MORGAN'S KMI.N COLORADO INTERSTATE GAS COMPANY, L.L.C (CIG):
DECLARES FORCE MAJEURE AT LINE 155A BETWEEN GREASEWOOD AND WAMSUTTER
SAYS IT HAS IDENTIFIED ANOMALIES ON LINE 155A WHICH IMPACTS THE SAFETY AND INTEGRITY OF THE PIPELINE, AND WHICH REQUIRES IMMEDIATE ATTENTION
SAYS THE REPAIRS WILL REQUIRE A PRESSURE RESTRICTION, ISOLATION AND A CORRESPONDING REDUCTION IN OPERATIONAL CAPACITY
